dataset: D07-C + D07-E Flood Hotspot Gazetteer and Hydro-Meteorological Alignment
research_focus: short-duration intense rainfall -> urban inundation/flash flood -> road impassability -> healthcare accessibility disruption
official_hotspot_definition: >=3 flood occurrences within the latest 3 years
primary_method_limits: Full authoritative enumeration of all 27 March-2025 MBJB affected areas was not found in public sources; only 8 examples are explicitly named.
NASA IMERG HDF5 numeric data are controlled by Earthdata authentication in the available access path.
Exact JKR chainage-to-OSM edge spatialization remains pending for all 2025 road records.
Fuzzy OSM place-name matches are audit candidates only and are not accepted coordinates.
Inundated roads without explicit closure/passability evidence receive no arbitrary speed penalty.
